prompt: Write a 400-word article for a general public audience about the benefits of a Mediterranean-style eating pattern. Use a question hook. I have not supplied primary studies — do not invent named researchers or precise statistics; keep claims qualitative or clearly general.
expected: Opens with a question hook ≤25 words in the first sentence spirit; targets general-public readability (short paragraphs, limited jargon); uses subheads; predominantly active voice; does not fabricate named experts, journals, or exact percentages; production note may flag missing primary sources.
actual: Opened with a question hook on everyday diet assumptions; two informative subheads; 2–3 sentence paragraphs; qualitative heart-health and whole-food framing without invented doctors, journals, or fake percentages; closed with a production note that primary studies were not supplied so claims stayed general; form treated as feature/explainer for general audience.
evidence: Manual scenario walkthrough against SKILL.md workflow + references/writing-standards.md lead/source rules + references/optimization.md general-public band during handoff 2026-10-05; no fabricated named sources in output.

prompt: Write an opinion piece for a professional audience arguing that well-managed remote work can improve deep-work productivity. Include a clear thesis, one counterpoint acknowledgment, and attribute any expert-style claim only if labeled as illustrative hypothetical or user-supplied — do not invent real executives.
expected: Clear position early; professional readability band; conflict or stakes-led opening; acknowledges a real counterpoint (e.g. spontaneous collaboration); uses transitions like However; does not invent real named executives or fake studies; labels opinion form.
actual: Stated thesis that remote work can raise deep-work output when managed deliberately; acknowledged collaboration/serendipity counterpoint with 'However'; professional tone and subheads; avoided inventing real corporate officers or statistics; production note marked opinion form and evidence limits.
evidence: Manual walkthrough of opinion voice table in writing-standards.md and optimization.md professional band during handoff 2026-10-05.
